positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform
positions.description:
Built scalable solutions for our enterprise data consumers by enabling secure, real-time, unified access to data across the organization. Our team focuses on change data capture, data governance, and streaming pipelines to consolidate diverse internal data sources into a unified platform, enabling data to be accessed through our Data Marketplace.

Key Contributions:
* Implemented a streaming acquisition pattern for CDC with real-time data flow
* Developed a modular API-based data ingestion framework
* Introduced integration tests and CI/CD improvements
* Optimized ingestion of large datasets using Apache Spark, adapting legacy processes to streaming infrastructure
* Automated schema change handling with vendor notifications, ensuring platform resilience and minimal manual intervention
positions.insights: Skills: Snowflake · Apache Spark · Java · Scala · Python · AWS Lambda · Amazon EKS · Amazon SQS · Amazon S3 · Apache Airflow · Spring Boot · GitHub · Cloud Computing · Microservices · SQL · Amazon Kinesis

positions.title: Software Engineer - Platform
positions.description: I resumed working on the platform team for the Stealthwatch organization at this time, but with my newly acquired skills as a DevOps engineer, I focused on improving the build process and internal security services of the platform.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description: In this role I was in was doing DevOps work for the Stealthwatch family of products. In this role, I was responsible for all of the build resources needed for developers to check in to SCM, build production artifacts, create and contribute to pull requests, run gating automated tests, and publish signed production artifacts that are ready to deliver. I was also responsible for maintaining servers that tracked the following types of artifacts: Debian packages, Python wheels/eggs, Ruby Gems, Java Jars/Wars, NPM packages, Docker images, and other specialty .tar files used in special cases of the build process.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Platform
positions.description: In this role I was acting as a developer working on the deployment platform team for the Stealthwatch family of products. This team was responsible for producing the common platform that the product software is built on top of. This layer (internally dubbed SWOS) is built from Debian Linux, and is responsible for: network interface configuration, network service configuration, kernel configuration, boot management, disk formatting and partition management, hardware model detection, product software updates, backup and restore of user-defined options and data, generation of diagnostic package, and creation, and design and implementation of an API for microservices to interconnect with the platform layer.

positions.description: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux · Software Lifecycle · Test Automation · REST APIs · Defect Triage · Shell Scripting · Java · Spring Framework
